subject: Risk acceptance checklist and MAP milestones — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@finquik.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Oct 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP risk acceptance checklist and security gates — initial

Hi Soojin / Redwood team,

Thanks for the demo last week — FinQuik is excited to move this forward. Attaching our draft MAP spreadsheet (FinQuik-MAP-v1.xlsx) with the security/compliance gates we need to close before procurement signs off. High level asks in the sheet include: SOC 2 readiness evidence, SIG/CAIQ answers, a DPA with EU data residency options, and an explicit data retention matrix for PII / transaction logs / embeddings.

Quick questions to help us slot this into our timeline:
- Can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 report date (most recent) and whether it covers dedicated and private deployments?
- Do you have a completed SIG/CAIQ or a CAIQ-export we can review?
- For the DPA, our legal team prefers to propose a 30-day redline turnaround. Who should we send the redline to?
- We need to lock retention tiers: 90d for session logs, 1y for aggregated telemetry, embeddings must be deletable on request. Is that supported?

Goal: firm acceptance/no-blocker decision by Oct 27 so our procurement can start redlining. Can your team confirm a single point of contact for SOC 2 evidence and DPA redlines?

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Head of Platform Security
FinQuik
attachments: FinQuik-MAP-v1.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@finquik.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Oct 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP risk acceptance checklist and security gates — initial

Alex — thanks for the clear asks and the MAP doc. Looping Rishi (security ops) and Lauren (account lead) onto the thread so we can align on evidence and timeline.

Short answers up front:
- SOC 2: our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering hosted and dedicated, with scoped notes for Private deployments) is Q2 2028. I'll attach the summary (Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf) and coordinate the full report access under an NDA if needed.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a CAIQ-export and a mapped answer spreadsheet; Rishi will drop the export and a short mapping doc by end of day Thu.
- DPA: please send redline to legal@redwoodinference.com. For MAPs we aim for a 48–72 hour initial acknowledgment and then work with you on line-by-line.
- Retention: current platform supports configurable retention windows per data class; session logs can be set to 90 days, aggregated telemetry to 1 year, and embeddings can be either short-lived or stored with deletion-on-request workflows. There are two implementation options we recommend (see bullets below).

Proposed MAP milestone plan (high level):
1) 10/18 — Redwood provides SOC2 summary + CAIQ-export + retention implementation options (we can host a 30m walkthrough).
2) 10/20 — FinQuik returns any critical open items and sends DPA redline.
3) 10/23 — Joint review of DPA redline + evidence handoff.
4) 10/27 — Mutual acceptance decision (go/no-go for procurement).

Retention implementation options (short):
- Option A (managed): Redwood configures tenant-level retention profiles in your Dedicated instance; deletion-on-request via support+audit trail; recommended for minimal operational lift.
- Option B (self-managed): For Private deployments, we provide guidance and scripts to enforce retention in your environment; you'd own enforcement and audit but keep full control.

Rishi, can you confirm CAIQ ETA and whether there are any SOC2 carveouts we should flag to FinQuik?

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Account Security
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@finquik.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Megan Li <megan.li@procurecloud.io>, security@finquik.com
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP risk acceptance checklist and security gates — initial

Thanks Soojin — that plan looks reasonable. A couple of clarifications from FinQuik:
- We'll schedule the walkthrough for 10/18 at 11am PT, please confirm Rishi can present the CAIQ mapping.
- Our legal team (copied: Megan Li) will send a DPA redline by 10/20 EOD. Megan — we'll send the DocuSign envelope once the redline is accepted; otherwise we'll route through procurement.
- On retention: Option A preferred, but we need proof the deletion flow generates an immutable audit log for compliance. Is that available today or a roadmap item?

If Redwood can provide the CAIQ export and SOC2 addendum before the walkthrough, we can use that time to confirm outstanding items and keep the Oct 27 acceptance target.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Platform Security, FinQuik

> On Wed, 17 Oct 2028 at 09:07, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Rishi, can you confirm CAIQ ETA and whether there are any SOC2 carveouts we should flag to FinQuik?
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@finquik.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Oct 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP risk acceptance checklist and security gates — initial

Alex / Soojin / team — follow-up from our side after the CAIQ export review and retention demo yesterday. Short summary and next steps below.

Summary:
- CAIQ export: attached under separate secure link; highlights: all control families answered, a few items are "partial" for Private deployments (noted in the export) — I'll include the mapping notes in the shared Drive.
- SOC 2: no open carveouts that would block an enterprise go decision; standard scope notes for Private deployments documented in the summary you received.
- Deletion + audit trail: Option A supports deletion-on-request with an append-only audit trail that captures requestor, timestamp, object id and action. We can produce a demo extract for compliance to ingest.

Action items and owners:
- Redwood (Rishi): upload CAIQ mapping doc + demo extract for deletion audit by 10/22 EOD.
- FinQuik (Alex / Megan): send DPA redline by 10/20 EOD (per plan).
- Redwood (Soojin / Lauren): prep a one-pager tying the MAP milestones to procurement checkpoints for your legal and procurement teams by 10/23.

Acceptance path: if the DPA redline is non-substantive and the deletion-audit demo satisfies FinQuik, we will treat Oct 27 as the MAP mutual-acceptance date and move procurement forward. If significant redlines appear, we'll schedule a 30-min escalation with legal.

I'll post the CAIQ link to the shared Drive and confirm once it's available.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: FinQuik-CAIQ-export.csv (secure link), Deletion-audit-demo.json (demo extract)
